title: Affine algebra derived pullback preserves quasi-coherence
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Put $\mathcal A=f_*\mathcal O_X$ and $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal A)$ as in [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Use the unbounded derived categories of sheaves of modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with $Rg_*$ as in [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Let $L:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$ be any functor with an adjunction $L\dashv Rg_*$. If $M$ has quasi-coherent $\mathcal A$-module cohomology [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], then $L(M)$ has quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module cohomology [def-pc-derived-category].

proof.text: Apply the ringed-space derived adjunction to get a tensor pullback functor P with its object formula, morphism formula and additivity, a left-derived D with comparison epsilon, and an adjunction D left adjoint to Rg_*.

The affine exactness theorem supplies preservation of finite limits and finite colimits by P. Mathlib Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh and Functor.isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_inverts show that P.mapDerivedCategory is a left-derived functor of the same homotopy-category functor. Functor.leftDerivedUnique identifies D with P.mapDerivedCategory. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq identifies L with D.

For every n, apply ringed-space tensor-pullback preservation of quasi-coherence to H^n(M), using the specified object equality for P. Functor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso identifies P(H^n(M)) with H^n(P.mapDerivedCategory(M)). Map the inverse of the component of L isomorphic to P.mapDerivedCategory through the homology functor. Compose the two isomorphisms and apply ObjectProperty.prop_of_iso for SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent. This proves the claim in every integer degree.

theorem affine_algebra_derived_pullback_preserves_qcoh
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))) ⥤
      schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (adj : L ⊣ RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)) :
    (∀ M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))),
      directImageAlgebraDerivedQCohProperty f M →
        schemeDerivedQCohProperty X (L.obj M))
